name: luxury-magazine-editorial
image_purpose: luxury magazine editorial and fashion campaign

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman standing and leaning slightly against a counter in a modern indoor setting.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with dark brown-to-black hair in a sleek ponytail, natural glam makeup, luminous realistic skin texture, soft rosy blush, defined eyes, and a confident natural smile. She wears a supplied metallic silver chainmail cowl-neck halter ensemble with an asymmetrical skirt and small supplied jewelry.
composition_elements: Mid-length waist-up-to-thigh portrait, subject leaning slightly against a counter with shoulders back and head gently tilted.
Minimal softly blurred modern interior with counter surface, neutral luxury palette, and clean negative space.
Preserve chainmail drape, reflective texture, asymmetrical hem, jewelry, pose, and direct editorial presence.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft front-and-side studio lighting with gentle shadows, controlled metallic reflections, subtle skin glow, and cinematic highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp face and chainmail texture, realistic hair strands and pores, slight grain, balanced warm grade, no text or watermark.
